meta.title: Mentorix — the coaching platform for fitness professionals
meta.description: Build training programs, onboard clients in one tap, and track real results. Mentorix is the all-in-one workspace for coaches and personal trainers.
meta.keywords: fitness coaching software, personal trainer app, workout program builder, client management, training analytics, online coaching platform

hero.badge: One platform for trainers & their clients
hero.title: Coach more clients. Do less busywork.
hero.subtitle: Mentorix brings trainers and their clients together in one calm workspace: build programs, onboard in a single tap, and keep a finger on the pulse of every client's progress — instead of chasing admin work.
hero.note: Free plan available · No credit card required

features.title: Everything your coaching business needs
features.subtitle: One workspace to plan, deliver and measure your training — no spreadsheets, no juggling apps.

library.title: Exercise library
library.description: Curate a personal library of movements with muscle groups, equipment and difficulty — global or private to you.

builder.title: Drag-and-drop program builder
builder.description: Design multi-week programs visually: weeks, days and exercise blocks with progression in a guided wizard.

invites.title: One-tap client onboarding
invites.description: Invite clients with a single Telegram link. They join instantly — no passwords, no friction.

analytics.title: Real-time analytics
analytics.description: Track active clients, completions and weekly drop-off for every program at a glance.

versioning.title: Versioning & publishing
versioning.description: Draft, publish and roll out updates to clients while keeping a full version history.

global.title: Global by default
global.description: A fully localized experience for your clients, with English and Russian out of the box.

preview.title: See Mentorix in action
preview.subtitle: A calm, focused workspace your whole coaching practice runs on.

howItWorks.title: Up and running in three steps
howItWorks.subtitle: From idea to a coached client in an afternoon.

one.title: Build your program
one.description: Assemble weeks and workouts from your exercise library in minutes.

two.title: Invite your client
two.description: Share a Telegram invite link — your client is onboarded in one tap.

three.title: Track & improve
three.description: Watch completion and engagement in real time and iterate with confidence.

mobile.title: Mentorix in your pocket
mobile.description: Native iOS & Android apps are on the way — coach on the go, get instant client notifications, and review progress from anywhere. For now, Mentorix works great in your mobile browser.
features: Review & tweak programs on the go

pricing.title: Simple pricing that grows with you
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Move up as your roster grows — exact limits are shown in your account.
pricing.note: Upgrade or downgrade anytime as your roster grows.

cta.title: Ready to grow your coaching business?
cta.subtitle: Join coaches who run their entire practice on Mentorix.
